campaign_scope.logits: For each fixture prompt, record the complete bf16 vocabulary vector at the final prefill position as a digest-checked raw bf16 sidecar. Do not derive the floor from an argmax alone.
campaign_scope.prompts: The three strings in tests/fixtures/reference_inputs.json:prompts, whose committed file SHA-256 is 8e92bfaf4c602f28cd5d75305afaba810a32cd857efa9878a7ae1074c71eed40.
campaign_scope.token_stream: Record 32 direct-cache greedy tokens per fixture prompt; only the resulting measured common prefix may later be frozen as an exact golden.

convergence_rule: Run exactly five fresh interpreter processes at each preregistered thread count. If any greedy token, complete-logit vector, or recorded tap differs within any thread-count cell, run five additional fresh interpreter processes at every preregistered thread count before deriving the 95% deterministic-bootstrap interval and exact common greedy prefix; otherwise derive those values from the initial five-run cells. Never pool differing thread-count cells or derive a tolerance from fewer than five processes.

environment_control.torch_num_threads: the cell's thread_count, set before loading the model
